newsitem.title: USA: Summit closes on $150 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Summit closes on $150 mln credit line.

text.p: Summit Properties Inc said Wednesday that it has closed on a three-year unsecured revolving line of credit of $150 million.

The line will bear interest at LIBOR plus 110 basis points, but the spread will be cut to 95 basis points upon achievement of a BBB credit rating, with a further cut to 80 basis points at a BBB+ credit rating, Summit said.
Summit designs, develops and manages apartment communities with a focus in Atlanta, Charlotte, the Raleigh-Durham area, Washington, D.C., and Virginia and central and south Florida.
